articles.summary: Enters Peak Selling Season With Momentum Amid Growing Revenue, Re-Occurring Revenue and Digital Revenue While Expanding Margins and Net Income McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH) (“McGraw Hill” or the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced financial results for the fiscal first quarter 2027 ended June 30, 2026. Key Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Highlights Total revenue of $549.9 million, an increase of 2.6% year-over-year, driven by strong execution in Higher Education and K-12 segments. Re-occurring revenue of $425.6 million, an increase of 9.8% year-over-year, representing 77% of total revenue. Digital revenue of $353.5 million, an increase of 8.8% year-over-year, underscoring the strength of the Company’s technology-based solutions, which are deeply embedded in the learning experience. articles.summary: Exclusive integration will bring assessment developed at the Stanford Graduate School of Education, Reading and Dyslexia Research Program to K–12 classrooms around the world Key takeaways: Exclusive integration adds ROAR, the only literacy screener designed to assess foundational reading skills across the full K–12 continuum, to McGraw Hill's literacy portfolio. ROAR, developed at the Stanford University Graduate School of Education, Reading and Dyslexia Research Program, extends McGraw Hill's ability to support educators in connecting assessment, curriculum and intervention. Expanding state requirements and focus on literacy screening are underscoring demand for solutions that identify student needs and support targeted, individualized instruction. The ROAR Foundational Reading Skills Suite is already approved for use in multiple states, including California. McGraw Hill, Inc. articles.summary: McGraw Hill , Inc. The call will take place on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, at 2:00 PM ET.
